Guild Bank Command Center

A field guide to the 67 commands that keep your guild bank running. Each one shows what it does, an example and the result. Tap an example to copy it.

Good to know
Player name with a space? Use an underscore or quotes: !setacc Player_1 or !setacc "Player 1"
Authorized users have non-deductible balances by default. They are administrators and cannot use Donate.
R4+ users have similar access by default. Match your minimum rank settings to the permissions you intend.
The bank pauses during long tasks like hero stages. Use a custom chapter, 3-star unlocks, Sweep and X10.
